Cartoon Umbrella 1.0 — Golem Kin Games
https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/3d/props/exterior/cartoon-umbrella-285322
Uses the original prefab, mesh and three materials. The approved B variation
keeps the curved dome and pole, drops the padded underside, and renders the
upper cloth surface from both sides. The curve's vertical scale is .8; this is
not the rejected flat-sheet preview. Full model height is normalized to 2.36 m.
Fixed cantilever shelters keep their offset supports and original footprint.
Actual canopy geometry provides shadows; placement bounds follow the canopy.

Acquired 2026-11-09. Standard Unity Asset Store EULA:
https://unity.com/legal/as-terms
Original asset hashes and source paths are recorded in the imported package's
source.json. Source asset bytes are retained; Unity import settings and generated
rendering assets are adapted for Built-in rendering.
